The side-territory histogram is a fresh local numeric array and writes only if ds >= 0 and ds < sides.length. ds normally comes from the typed dominant-side grid. Prototype-property strings fail the positive numeric comparison, so remote taint does not permit arbitrary prototype writes here.

The ownership frequency table is a fresh Uint16Array. Only owner > 0 values from the numeric world-control grid reach the increment; prototype-property names cannot satisfy that condition. Noncanonical numeric inputs cannot alter Object.prototype or another application object through this local frequency table.

buildDirectionField uses simulation-core-owned frontlineScratch, not scratch supplied by the worker message; source/queue buffers are allocated Int32Arrays. cloneSimulationData intentionally copies game records into fresh data objects. It strips functions and asset fields and excludes prototype-chain keys, all Object.prototype names and array prototype names before assignment. Country/config merges use the same safeguards and root state fields are allowlisted; attacker data cannot replace inherited methods through this sink.
